399902.DESCRIPTION: ITC measurements were conducted on a Microcal iTC200 (Malvern Instruments) in buffer consisting of 25 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and 100 mM NaCl. Proteins were exchanged into ITC buffer by gel filtration using a Superdex200 column. Wild-type modified synthetic peptides were purchased from Genscript and are described in Results. One millimolar PTHR peptides (wild-type and mutant variants) were titrated into 100 μM individual proteins, PDZ1 or PDZ2, at 25 °C.

original_paragraph.ITC Measurements: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry (ITC) measurements were conducted on a Microcal iTC200 (Malvern Instruments) in buffer consisting of 25 mM Tris (pH 8.0) and 100 mM NaCl. Proteins were exchanged into ITC buffer by gel filtration using a Superdex200 column. Wild-type modified synthetic peptides were purchased from Genscript and are described in Results. One millimolar PTHR peptides (wild-type and mutant variants) were titrated into 100 μM individual proteins, PDZ1 or PDZ2, at 25 °C. Data were processed using ORIGIN (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) to extract the thermodynamic parameters ΔH°, Kd (1/Ka), and stoichiometry, n. ΔG° and ΔS° were derived from the relationships ΔG° = −RT ln Ka and ΔG° = ΔH° − TΔS°.
